address: 96 Liwun Road, Zuoying District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan
bio: Unlike your average braised pork rice shops that sometimes feel a bit old hat, this one boasts a bright, simple interior with full-length windows and a cartoon pig logo that appeals to younger audiences. Notwithstanding the trendy vibe, the score focuses on good old Taiwanese staples. Braised pork rice is a must, which can be topped with an over-easy egg or extra meat. There is also a range of side dishes, seasonal veggie plates and soups available.
